title: Questions 181-185 refer to the following advertisement and review.
passage_1:
Grand Opening: The Cocoa Vault

We are delighted to bring small-batch chocolate making to the riverside quarter. Owned and operated by Solene Marchetti, formerly of the famous Maison Trebor, The Cocoa Vault offers a wide range of freshly tempered chocolate every morning.

Our shelves carry everything from single-origin bars to filled pralines. To show our gratitude to our new neighbours, we are giving 25 percent off all purchases over £20 until 9 November.

Please note that while most products are available daily except Tuesdays when we are closed, our signature Smoked Sea Salt Caramel is a special weekend treat, available exclusively on Sundays. Early arrival is recommended because this popular item sells out rapidly! Furthermore, join us on Thursdays for our free tasting events and on Saturdays for our early-bird hot chocolate beverages.

https://www.riversidetastes.com/forum/cocoa-vault

Source: Riverside Tastes Forum
Posted by: Wren Okafor (w_okafor)
Date: 5 November
Rating: ★★★★☆

I finally stopped by The Cocoa Vault after hearing so much about it. I went in particular for the Smoked Sea Salt Caramel that my colleagues had mentioned about multiple times. I am glad I did, because the balance was unique and the finish was perfect. The prices are quite affordable too. I picked up four pralines as well, and the bill came to just £24.

I was also impressed by the service. I was pleasantly surprised to find a handwritten appreciation card from Ms. Marchetti tucked into my box. It is rare to find an owner who pays that much attention to individual customers.

There was, however, one problem during my visit. The lighting in the shop was so dim that I could barely read the labels on the counter. They should have this problem fixed immediately.
